text:
Elaine: Heads-up — quick bring-up of Llama-3-12B int8 on bench. Initial eval vs float16 shows median Rouge-L down ~1.8 pts on our summarization set.
Sam: Hmm, that's larger than I expected for int8. What's the prompt/temperature? :thinking:
Elaine: temp=0.2, greedy sampling, 512 context. Eval harness id `onboard/2051/llama3-12b-int8/v1`.
Priya: Do you have token-level cost and latency numbers? tradeoffs matter for product.
Elaine: yes — avg latency @ batch=1 = 420ms/token, avg tokens/resp=120, GPU cost/unit ~0.28 $/k tokens; float16 baseline latency 380ms/token and cost 0.62 $/k tokens.
Ben: So int8 halves cost but adds ~40ms/token and loses ~1.8 Rouge-L. For some features that's ok, others not.
Priya: We need per-slice quality breakdown. Small drop on news summarization might be fine, but hallucination or instruction-following regressions are problematic.
Elaine: Agreed. Attached quick slice: `topics=[news,docs,conversational]` => news -1.1, docs -2.4, conversational -2.0.
Sam: Docs drop >2 is concerning. Can we try hybrid routing: int8 for news, float16 for docs? What's the cost impact? 
Elaine: Estimated routing policy: 65% int8 / 35% float16 -> unit cost ~0.42 $/k tokens (vs 0.62 baseline). Latency SLOs still met for 95p if batching applied.
EvalBot: Automated eval run complete: regression flagged on `citation_accuracy` metric for docs slice (p=0.03). Recommend targeted checks.
Ben: Next steps proposal: 1) Hold default rollout (no prod flip). 2) Run targeted RLHF prompt-sensitivity checks on docs slice. 3) Run small A/B with canary traffic 1% + quality guardrails for 24h. 4) Explore 6-bit quant or quant-aware fine-tune.
Priya: Also add unit-econ scorecard entry: compute cost delta per 1M tokens, expected MRR impact if quality cutoff triggered. I can draft.
Sam: Can Priya and Elaine sync on the scorecard and create a canary config in `redwood/svc/routing/llama3-12b-int8-canary`? I'll own rollout automation.
Elaine: I'll push eval artifacts and a short reproduction script:
```
python eval_harness.py --model llama3-12b --quant int8 --slices docs,news --out results.json
```
Ben: Sounds good. If docs declines persist, fallback policy = float16 for `docs` slice + notify GTM.
Priya: tagging @product: if we keep int8 for news and convers. we can hit ~30% cost reduction for chat features, but need product sign-off on docs SLA.
Sam: ok. I'll open a 1% canary and set quality monitors. Elaine send the eval link once uploaded.
Elaine: uploaded -> https://artifacts.redwood/2051/llama3-12b-int8/v1/results.json :thumbsup:
Ben: thanks — let's reconvene after 24h canary. :calendar:
